classification.question_topic: Whether others share similar recurring/interconnected 'Mallworld' areas/zones from the author's dream map

meta.author_theory: Dreams are interconnected into a mapped set of distinct areas/zones; some are 'MallWorld' areas; 'intra-space' appears when walking out of bounds; 'sublayer' hallway connects pink zones/doors.

extraction.extraction_notes: Post lists 111 zones and references a map image link; only a subset could be fully instantiated as LocationVisit objects within a single extraction. Many additional named zones are present but not exhaustively converted to locations here. Image content was not directly provided beyond the preview URL; map-specific spatial relations beyond text (e.g., exact adjacency/positions on map) could not be extracted.
